title: Normal integral geometry and common generic stalk of a smooth connected family
statement: Let S be integral with integrally closed local rings, c:C → S a smooth morphism with geometrically connected fibres, and C nonempty [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let q:Cη → Spec K(S), j:Cη → C be a cartesian generic fibre [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then C and Cη are integral with integrally closed local rings. There is an isomorphism e:Spec K(C) ≅ Spec K(Cη) such that (e.hom; Cη.fromSpecStalk(η_Cη));j=C.fromSpecStalk(η_C). No Noetherian, quasi-compactness or separatedness hypothesis is imposed on S or C.

source.place: Tags 034F, 056T and 01UA; generic-fibre localization of the generic stalk

proof.text: Apply smooth_connected_generic_geometry_core to obtain integral structures on C and Cη and their normal local rings. Register the two integral structures, apply the proved smooth_connected_generic_geometry_stalk_iso, and combine the witnesses.

proof_origin.note: Decomposition: the normal-integrality core remains open; the common generic stalk theorem is proved from Mathlib.

mathlib_searches.results: LeanFinder returned normalization-preserves-integrality and IsIntegral; none proves smooth normality plus common generic stalk. Source Regular.lean proves geometric irreducibility over fields, not this complete statement.

No matching complete geometry theorem. SmoothNormalRing gives affine normality ascent only; Regular gives field-base regularity only; FunctionField contains canonical generic stalk maps but no generic-fibre geometry package.

lean.statement: theorem smooth_connected_generic_geometry {S C : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral S] [Nonempty C] (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x)) (c : C ⟶ S) [Smooth c] [GeometricallyConnected c] {Cη : Scheme.{u}} (q : Cη ⟶ Spec S.functionField) (j : Cη ⟶ C) (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c) : ∃ hC : IsIntegral C, letI := hC; ∃ hη : IsIntegral Cη, letI := hη; (∀ x : C, IsIntegrallyClosed (C.presheaf.stalk x)) ∧ (∀ x : Cη, IsIntegrallyClosed (Cη.presheaf.stalk x)) ∧ ∃ e : Spec C.functionField ≅ Spec Cη.functionField, (e.hom ≫ Cη.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Cη)) ≫ j = C.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint C)
